The '''Battle of Udnil II''' was a space battle between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] that took place when Rebel starfighters mounted a bold assault on the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Tormentor/Legends|Tormentor]]'' as it rendezvoused with a supply convoy in the [[Udnil system/Legends|Udnil system]], near the [[Udnil II|second planet]].

==The battle==
The ''Tormentor'' was taking delivery of ten [[Class-A cargo container]]s and rendezvousing with Munro Group, a small convoy of [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighters]], when a Rebel force consisting of [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Squadron]], flying [[BTL-A4 Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing attack starfighters]], and [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]], flying [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing superiority starfighters]], dropped out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], probably in the [[Gravity well/Legends|gravity well]] of Udnil II or near it. Munro Group exited the system almost as quickly as they entered it as the Rebels began their audacious attack.

The ''Imperial''-class warship, however, was not without its own starfighter defenses. A dozen [[TIE/ad starfighter|TIE Avengers]], at the time considered to be among the best starfighters in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], moved to intercept the attack fighters and destroy the Rebels before they could inflict too much damage on the ''Tormentor'' or its convoy, including the [[Heavy Lifter/Legends|Heavy Lifter]] ''Bellboy''. To defend themselves against the fast, well-armed TIEs, the Rebels may have called in elements of [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue Squadron]], which was equipped with agile [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing interceptors]].

==Behind the scenes==
As players can participate in the mission "Attack on Imperial-class Star Destroyer Tormentor" in the computer game ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter]]'' on either the Rebel or the Imperial side, both sides have conflicting mission objectives, and victory is not essential to access the next set of missions, the battle itself is considered canon but the canon outcome is unknown.

The ships listed in this article are those found in the battle [[Operation: Clean Sweep]], using the default craft assigned to the player.
